output.subject: We've received your message about your missing paycheck
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about your paycheck. We understand how worrying it is when expected pay doesn't show up, especially when an important bill depends on it.

We have received your complaint. Here is what you told us:

- Your employer says they sent your paycheck on 9/10 to your account with us, but you mentioned it has not appeared in your account.
- When you asked your employer about it, they told you to speak with your bank.
- You told us your car insurance will be cancelled on 9/21/2026 if your payment doesn't go through.

You've asked us to locate the missing deposit and to have the funds credited to your account.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond within 10 business days. If your employer gives you any further details about the payment, you're welcome to reply to this message and share them.

We're sorry for the stress this situation has caused, and thank you for bringing it to us.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The customer's insurance cancellation date of 9/21/2026 may fall before the 10-business-day response window. Decide whether earlier contact is needed.
Check whether a deposit from the employer around 9/10 was received, pending, returned or rejected.
Confirm that the routing and account numbers the customer quoted match their account. Do not repeat these numbers in the reply.
The customer asked for the funds to be credited. That outcome is not addressed in the draft and needs your decision.
Consider whether to ask the customer for the employer's payment trace or confirmation details.
